messages:
anika: Quick sync idea: "commitment runway" + reserve tokens. goal: give mid-market customers predictable commit utilization across seasonal bursts without full smoothing complexity. short thread to align on scope.
ben: curious how this differs from smoothing bands?
anika: runway = customers pre-purchase a short-term reserve (tokens) that automatically top up their commit during spikes. unlike smoothing, tokens are finite, priced up-front, and convert at a fixed uplift. simpler billing math.
lena: sales: that sounds easier to sell to CFOs - one-time reserve purchase in contract. need clear seatbelt: how many tokens translate to what % headroom?
marco: infra: simpler than smoothing because it's not retrospective; we only need token consumption traces + a hard throttle when tokens exhausted. estimate: one infra sprint for token ledger + UI hooks.
sana: cs/legal: ask for clear language on token expiration and refund rules. propose tokens expire at contract anniversary and are non-refundable.
ben: pricing thought: price tokens at a 15-25% uplift over unit rate depending on term length. example: 10k tokens ~ allows 20% headroom for a $40k/mo commit for 30d. need finance to validate.
finance-bot: Quick calc (rough): for commit $40k/mo, 20% headroom = $8k. At 20% uplift token price ~ $9.6k. Suggest test price points: 10%, 20%, 40% uplift bands.
ananika: (typo)
anika: thanks finance-bot. Launch criteria (MVP): 1) token ledger + billing integration, 2) console display (tokens remaining + projected runout), 3) contract addendum template + expiry/refund policy, 4) sales one-pager + pricing table.
lena: product ask: tokens must be consumable across projects under same org; also show projected token depletion date in UI.
marco: ops safety: implement soft limit warnings at 50% token use and auto-throttle when both commit + tokens > 3x daily peak. tickets estimate: PRIC-RUNWAY-1 (ledger), PRIC-RUNWAY-2 (billing), PRIC-RUNWAY-3 (UI), PRIC-RUNWAY-4 (T&C).
sana: legal: need anti-abuse clause: repeated token top-ups without contract uplift will trigger review. propose 2x top-up limit per year without renegotiation.
ben: sales ask: allow token pilot bundle for 60d for new logos. helps close. also need migration path from burst credits -> tokens (pro-rate).
finance-bot: Risk note: tokens move revenue recognition earlier; finance needs pilot sample to measure impact.
anika: KPIs for pilot: token uptake %, avg token runout days, conversion to larger commit, number of forced throttles.
lena: rollout plan: pilot with 5 accounts (mix: 2 mid-market, 2 enterprise with seasonal traffic, 1 spiky startup). ben to nominate.
marco: ETA: 5w to pilot if we start this week.
anika: copy snippet for sales doc: "Reserve tokens are a pre-purchased buffer that top up your monthly commitment during spikes. Tokens expire at contract renewal and provide predictable spike capacity without retrospective billing."
ben: next steps: ben+lena pick pilots by Thu; marco scope tickets; sana draft contract addendum; finance to approve price bands. @pricing-bot create epic PRIC-RUNWAY. :rocket:
pricing-bot: Created epic PRIC-RUNWAY (https://go/repo/PRIC-RUNWAY) - owners: anika, marco, lena.
